audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Harvey’s entire special dinner event, including every pasta-tasting response and every account-of-the-day response branch. All twenty-eight spoken lines and thirteen player choices were reviewed for medical and culinary meaning, character voice, humor, intimacy, gender branch, activity context, and the angel-hair, moustache, fungus, hydration and burnout references. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, quick-question branch counts, placeholders, gender and dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Together with the preceding batches, all FarmHouse records are covered; the full-locale final audits remain pending.
